profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading on public markets under the ticker META. Its most recent annual filing reported revenue of $200,966,000,000. The company's AI-facing site presents it as a platform for developers to build with Meta's AI models and tools, centered on the Llama open-weight model family and accessed through the Meta Model API, which the site describes as compatible with the OpenAI SDK.

The site highlights several products under the Muse name. Muse Spark is described as optimized for coding, able to write, review, and ship code with fewer steps and lower latency, and positioned as competitive for coding agents, reviewing bots, and AI-assisted development. Muse Image is available through the Meta Model API at $0.01 per image and is described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits. The site also describes multi-agent workflow capabilities built on a single model that can interact with a computer by clicking through apps and moving between interfaces. Additional developer features include search grounding, which gives models live access to the web via a single tool added to a request.

The held facts note three active legal cases involving Meta Platforms, Inc., filed in federal district courts in Texas and California, including Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc., alongside a count of 174 California-linked legal exposures. Several third-party MCP servers reference Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
